name: repopilot
description: RepoPilot monorepo: a FastAPI agent service, a React terminal UI, and the wire contract they share.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @repopilot/contracts && npm run build --workspace @repopilot/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @repopilot/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @repopilot/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run api:lint && npm run api:test
